text: Repeated in steps, so each cut has its own melting range. Other refining steps named in the chapter: polishing (wash with 20-30 % water), neutralisation, decholesterolisation (with beta-cyclodextrin, centrifuged out).

steps.note: The anhydrous milk fat is melted.
The milk fat is cooled to the temperature at which the wanted fraction crystallises.
The fraction is filtered on special filters.
What passes through is cooled further for the next fraction, and so on.
